title: Namespace Shot Pattern Tests to Prevent Repository Collection Collisions
body:
The full affected-test gate found that the new un-packaged test_core.py shadows tests/unit/tools/native_viewer_export/test_core.py under pytest prepend imports. Focused tests alone did not reveal the collision.

## Acceptance Criteria

Make the shot-pattern test directories proper packages without changing unrelated tests or ignoring collection errors. Demonstrate red collection from the canonical runner then green simultaneous collection and rerun relevant tests.

## Validation

Canonical pre-PR log records import-file mismatch for bare test_core. Package markers and simultaneous collection must remove it.

## Handoff

Branch `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`; keep open until merged implementing PR.
